messages:
Renee (CSM): Quick heads-up: Eng found a billing/quotas bug that briefly throttled writes to the embeddings ingestion during several customer onboarding imports between 11:03-11:26 PT. Affected: 6 onboarders; 2 paid POCs. Need coordinated status + credits + reschedule plan.
Tom (CS Ops): List the accounts and any near-term renewals so we can triage outreach.
Ivy (Eng): Root cause: an incorrect quota reconciliation job applied legacy soft-limits to new onboarding tenants during a datastore migration. That triggered automated write-throttles for about ~20 minutes. We reverted the reconciliation at 11:26 PT and cleared throttles; requeues ran starting 11:30. No data loss.
AlertBot: Incident INC-2026-412 created: quota-reconciliation-throttle. Severity: P2.
Jordan (Onboarding): I have three orientation calls today. Which customers should I reschedule proactively?
Renee (CSM): Impacted: NovaRetail, OpenLedger, ClinicSense, BrightForms (trial); CounselEdge (paid POC), DataWeave (paid POC). Prioritize CounselEdge and NovaRetail for outreach.
Tom (CS Ops): Draft status message (short):
Tom (CS Ops): "Hi <CustomerTeam>,

We experienced a brief issue between 11:03-11:26 PT that temporarily throttled some onboarding imports. Our engineers reverted the change and requeued affected work; most jobs are complete and the remainder should finish within 90 minutes.

We will send an RCA and account-specific remediation/credits as needed. Your CSM will follow up about any rescheduling.

- Redwood CS"

Kara (Billing): Quick note on credits: for paid POCs we can provision an interim credit up to $2,000 pending CSM impact notes; billing will finalize after we confirm reprocessing usage.
Ivy (Eng): Postmortem timeline: draft in 48h, final RCA in 72h. Fix: stop applying legacy quotas during migration, add reconciliation dry-run and canary, add alert for unexpected throttle spikes.
Jordan (Onboarding): I'll hold NovaRetail's 1pm slot for 30 minutes and call CounselEdge right away. Offer a "priority make-good" slot and a free 1:1 troubleshooting session.
Renee (CSM): Send status to all six now. For renewal-risk accounts offer exec sync if requested and flag for retention outreach. Also ask customers whether they saw confusing quota errors (screenshots helpful).
Tom (CS Ops): Sending status emails now with requeue ticket refs and CSM contacts. :email::white_check_mark:
AlertBot: Validation: requeues completed for 6/6 jobs at 12:05 PT. Incident status: mitigated.
Renee (CSM): Owners: Renee -> CounselEdge, NovaRetail; Jordan -> OpenLedger, ClinicSense, BrightForms; Tom -> outbound + ticket list; Kara -> provisional billing holds; Ivy -> eng postmortem.
Jordan (Onboarding): Adding a "post-incident feedback" field to each onboarding ticket to capture UX issues or unclear error messages.
Renee (CSM): I'll post the sent email copy here and follow up after the 48h draft is ready. Flag any customer escalations in this thread.
